dedupe_keys.name: 市道認定道路線網図 roads bridges and tunnels

description: 市道認定道路線網図 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 加古川市. 加古川市内の市道認定道路線網図に関する情報です。. Coverage: 加古川市. The portal files it under the publisher 加古川市. Its tags are 共用路線, 市道, 未共用路線, 線網図, 認定道路. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
